info:
Who once was a good and loving husband became a very horrible person that hurt Minnie terribly.

On that fateful day, was when his whole world finally turned upside down, who now suffers endlessly in a loop cursed upon him by his own lover...

Despite everything, he is determined to break free one day and finally end it all to just see Minnie one last time to say "Sorry."

Loving wife, abuse survivor, caster of the curse brought upon Avier...

After leaving her husband, out in the streets, she stumbles upon a stranger in an alleyway, who showed concern about her. Upon expressing feelings, this stranger offered a deal she could not resist!

Little did she know what she was REALLY getting herself into...

A false impersonator of Everett.

Created by Satan himself for him to wear as a disguise, with reference to the best of his ability with Everett's appearance up close by snatching him into a void.

Satan is clearly not the best at replicating him perfectly, as he got quite a few details wrong, alongside his appearance being fully white...

Torments Avier throughout the story, and eventually, pisses off others as well...

It was a normal hunting day for Goofy & Donald until one day, Goofy wasn't paying attention to where Donald went and heard some rustling he thought was deer.

He ended up accidentally shooting Donald instead, killing him due to believing he was another animal. Witnessing Donald's death caused by his own hands, his way of coping ended up being to blame the whole world for being the cause of Donald's death rather than himself.

Because of this, he now has a new goal in mind: To kill every living being in this world he deems to be at fault of Donald's death.

A grunt mouse who went rogue after having the only person who cared for him taken from his life.

He is VERY relentless and determined to win at all costs, as he does NOT like to be controlled by anyone.

He is made up of mixed DNA of some weird green clown and mostly ink, went through several failed experiments before any of the events leading up to this.

The ghost of Steamboat Willie, a ghostly apparition of the Mickey before.

Left to rot in the Disney vault after the creation of Mickey Mouse, White Noise now haunts the vault as a sorrowing spirit always wishing that he could've done something different.

White Noise is a shy and timid ghost, always avoiding conflict if necessary.

This creature comes from a tour bus video at the start of it on an animator's channel called "RubberRoss".

Was made as a bit meant to only last for 5 seconds of the video, where he was to represent America not letting someone in their group pass the border, represented by the big red line in the middle of the white void.

This dumbass comes back to this mod for 3 minutes now, and does not play fair.

A doctor who earned the nickname of "Mr. Smiles" due to him smiling so much. He's a brilliant yet sadistic serial killer, making his fascination with Mickey Mouse and his childhood plushie all the more eerie.

Upon getting a wife, he tried to suppress his murderous urges, but unfortunately, failed, leading to his wife, Celeste discovering his grusome scene in the basement.

Tragically, this lead to a confrontation that led to Adam succumbing to his death, leading to his tranformation of this disturbing entity, alongside his newfound powers.

Walt descended from the dark mannerisms inside Walt Disney's brain, a spirit consumes the loveable Mickey Mouse, giving him sentience. One dreadful death, and something awakened within him, his eyes began to become more human, his body stretched and his smile widened. 

Destroyed over the loss of his beloved Minnie Mouse, Determined to bring her back. He seeks out his creator, Walt Disney to persuade him into doing so. His lack of movement is very crucial, as he cannot live without an animator drawing out frames for him. Moving on his own deteriorates his physical form until he becomes unstable. Too much movement, and its curtains for him.

A version of Mickey whose sanity starts to dwindle as a result of Daisy Duck's suicide. 

He decided to go on a stroll as to help calm his mind...only for him to go insane in the end.

He wields a shotgun and starts having blood drip from his now static face. 

This follows similar events of the Blind ending route from the original game: Suicide Mouse Relapse

Omniversal asshole.

A goofball who could literally end the existence of pretty much everything, yet chooses not to, simply because he finds that boring. He can shapeshift into anything he wants, and he chose to be a square...

Has a very short temper, so he'll easily get angry or offended if you do something he doesn't like, for example:

Trespassing his property!

This little Mickey Mouse look-a-like is a youngin who's birthday is neverending! 

Literally. Every day is his birthday. Muckney is a bit of an airhead, but he's loveable all the same. He likes to blow balloons, and always has the goal to ruin a certain blue hedgehog's party, although he never makes it in time to do so. You wouldn't leave his birthday...

...right? 

He'd get sad if you left...
